Here’s a list of well-known **office furniture brand websites** categorized by type (premium, mid-range, budget-friendly, ergonomic, and sustainable):

---

### **Premium/Luxury Office Furniture Brands**
1. **Herman Miller** – [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)
   - Known for: Aeron Chair, Embody Chair, high-end ergonomic designs.
2. **Steelcase** – [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)
   - Known for: Gesture Chair, Think Chair, workplace solutions.
3. **Knoll** – [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)
   - Known for: Modernist designs, Saarinen tables, ergonomic seating.
4. **Haworth** – [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)
   - Known for: Zody Chair, adaptive workspaces.
5. **Vitra** – [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)
   - Known for: European design, Eames-inspired furniture.

---

### **Mid-Range Office Furniture Brands**
6. **IKEA (Business)** – [www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/business-furniture](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/business-furniture)
   - Known for: Affordable, modular designs (e.g., BEKANT, MARKUS chairs).
7. **Hon (HNI Corporation)** – [www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com)
   - Known for: Budget-friendly ergonomic chairs (e.g., Ignition, Nucleus).
8. **Global Furniture Group** – [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)
   - Known for: Office seating and workstations.
9. **Kimball International** – [www.kimballinternational.com](https://www.kimballinternational.com)
   - Known for: Commercial office solutions.
10. **Allsteel** – [www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)
   - Known for: Sustainable, modular office furniture.

---

### **Budget-Friendly & Online Retailers**
11. **Wayfair (Office Furniture)** – [www.wayfair.com/furniture](https://www.wayfair.com/furniture)
   - Known for: Wide variety, frequent sales.
12. **Amazon Business** – [www.amazon.com/business](https://www.amazon.com/business)
   - Known for: Fast shipping, brands like **Hbada, SIHOO, Duramont**.
13. **Staples (Office Furniture)** – [www.staples.com/office-furniture](https://www.staples.com/office-furniture)
   - Known for: Affordable desks, chairs (e.g., **Hyken, Dexley**).
14. **Office Depot/OfficeMax** – [www.officedepot.com](https://www.officedepot.com)
   - Known for: Basic office setups.
15. **Uplift Desk** – [www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)
   - Known for: Standing desks (mid-to-high range).

---

### **Ergonomic & Specialty Brands**
16. **Autonomous** – [www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)
   - Known for: SmartDesk, ErgoChair (budget ergonomic options).
17. **Fully (formerly Ergonofis)** – [www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)
   - Known for: Jarvis standing desk, ergonomic accessories.
18. **Secretlab** – [www.secretlab.co](https://www.secretlab.co)
   - Known for: Gaming/office hybrid chairs (e.g., Titan, Omega).
19. **Branch Furniture** – [www.branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)
   - Known for: Ergonomic chairs (e.g., Ergonomic Chair, Verve).
20. **Humanscale** – [www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)
   - Known for: High-end ergonomic tools (e.g., Freedom Chair, monitor arms).

---

### **Sustainable/Eco-Friendly Brands**
21. **Eco-Balanza** – [www.eco-balanza.com](https://www.eco-balanza.com)
   - Known for: Non-toxic, handcrafted office furniture.
22. **Greenguard Certified Brands** (e.g., **Haworth, Steelcase**) – Check for [Greenguard certification](https://www.ul.com/services/greenguard-certification).
23. **Bureo** – [www.bureo.co](https://www.bureo.co) (for recycled-material desks).
24. **Emeco** – [www.emeco.net](https://www.emeco.net)
   - Known for: Recycled aluminum chairs (e.g., Navy Chair).

---

### **Custom/Modular Office Furniture**
25. **Bush Furniture** – [www.bushfurniture.com](https://www.bushfurniture.com)
   - Known for: Home office cabinets, L-shaped desks.
26. **Sauder** – [www.sauder.com](https://www.sauder.com)
   - Known for: Affordable RTA (ready-to-assemble) furniture.
27. **FlexiSpot** – [www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com)
   - Known for: Standing desks and ergonomic accessories.
28. **Vari** – [www.varidesk.com](https://www.varidesk.com)
   - Known for: Electric standing desks.

---

### **Luxury/Designer Office Furniture**
29. **Fritz Hansen** – [www.fritzhansen.com](https://www.fritzhansen.com)
   - Known for: Scandinavian design (e.g., Series 7 Chair).
30. **Arper** – [www.arper.com](https://www.arper.com)
   - Known for: Modern Italian office furniture.
31. **USM** – [www.usm.com](https://www.usm.com)
   - Known for: Modular steel storage systems.

---

### **Where to Compare Prices?**
- **Google Shopping** – [shopping.google.com](https://shopping.google.com)
- **Crutchfield (for tech + furniture combos)** – [www.crutchfield.com](https://www.crutchfield.com)
- **Madison Seating (for chairs)** – [www.madisonseating.com](https://www.madisonseating.com)

---
### **Tips for Buying Office Furniture Online:**
1. **Check return policies** (especially for ergonomic chairs).
2. **Look for warranties** (e.g., Herman Miller offers 12-year warranties).
3. **Read reviews** on Reddit (r/OfficeChairs, r/Ergonomics) or Wirecutter.
4. **Consider refurbished** (e.g., [Herman Miller Renew](https://www.hermanmiller.com/products/seating/office-chairs/renew/)).
